site.hero.headline.head: Bookings come in. Guests walk in.
site.hero.lead: Every reservation lands in one calendar. Kasify takes it from there — cleaners scheduled, guests checked in, SES.Hospedajes filed, and door codes generated.
site.hero.meta: First 3 properties free · No credit card required
site.channels.label: Syncs with
site.features.heading: Everything that runs a short-term rental, in one place.
site.features.sub: From the moment a booking lands in your inbox to the moment a guest walks out the door — Kasify takes care of the in-between.
site.feat.calendar.title: Unified calendar & booking sync
site.feat.calendar.body: Bookings from Airbnb, Booking.com, direct channels and any other iCal-compatible source are imported automatically. One timeline across every property — duplicates and overlaps surface instantly.
site.feat.multi.title: Multi-property
site.feat.multi.body: One account, many homes. Each property keeps its own calendar, team, tasks and integrations — with permissions kept separate.
site.feat.checkin.title: Online check-in & SES Hospedajes
site.feat.checkin.body: Guests complete check-in from a form before arrival. Kasify submits the registration to the Spanish guest registry automatically — Spanish STR compliance, handled.
site.feat.locks.title: Smart locks
site.feat.locks.body.html: Generate access codes tied to a reservation's exact dates with one click — no manual coordination, no leftover codes after checkout. Works with Nuki and UniFi out of the box, at no extra cost. No paid add-ons, no per-lock fees.
site.feat.team.title: Team access & tasks
site.feat.team.body: Invite cleaners, maintenance, contractors or co-managers per property. Each role sees only what they need — schedules, guest counts, checklists.
site.feat.guests.title: Guest management
site.feat.guests.body: A history of every guest, every stay. Spot returning visitors, review booking status, and reach out with offers for direct bookings.
site.feat.guests.miguel.name: Miguel García
site.feat.guests.tobias.name: Tobias Müller
site.how.heading: From iCal paste to autopilot.
site.how.sub.html: Connect your channels once. Kasify runs the rest of every booking — before, during and after the stay. Most hosts are live in under an hour.
site.how.step1.label: CONNECT · ONE-TIME
site.how.step1.title: Connect once.
site.how.step1.body: Paste your iCal links from Airbnb, Booking and any other channel you use. Bookings flow into one calendar — and stay there. About ten minutes, then never again.
site.how.step2.label: DURING · EVERY BOOKING
site.how.step2.title: Guests check themselves in.
site.how.step2.body: Kasify sends the form before arrival. ID verified, SES.Hospedajes filed, door code generated — automatically, in your guest's language.
site.how.step3.label: AFTER · ON ITS OWN
site.how.step3.title: Your day stays quiet.
site.how.step3.body: Cleaners scheduled, codes expired, calendar updated. You only get pinged when something actually needs you — never just for housekeeping.
site.pricing.heading: Three properties, free. Forever.
site.pricing.sub: No card, no time limit. Beyond 3 properties, founder accounts pay just €1 per property per month — locked in.
site.pricing.everyone.sub: Forever. No commitment, no time limit, no card required.
site.pricing.founder.sub.html: We may launch new plans later for future customers — your founder rate doesn't change.
site.pricing.foot: No credit card required. 3 properties always free. Founder rate locked in.
site.ew.headline.head: Every
site.ew.sub: There's no Pro tier waiting at the end of the funnel. Every account ships with every feature — including the API.
site.ew.kicker: No add-ons. No upsells. No commission. No contracts.
site.closing.heading.line2: Add the rest when you're ready.
site.closing.sub: Free for the first three. €1 each after that, locked in as a founder. Setup takes about 10 minutes.
site.foot.about: One calendar for every booking. Kasify handles the rest. Built for independent holiday-rental owners.
